a: \d matches a digit (0-9). \d+ matches one or more digits.
\w matches word characters [A-Za-z0-9_]. \W is the opposite.
^ matches start of string; $ matches end of string.
* means 0+, + means 1+, ? means 0 or 1, {n,m} means n to m times.
| means OR: cat|dog matches cat or dog.
[abc] matches a, b, or c. [^abc] matches anything except those.

```python
import re
m = re.search(r'\d+', 'id=42')
print(m.group() if m else None)
```
Tokenization splits text into units (words, subwords, or symbols) for NLP.
Stemming reduces words to a rough root (running → run) using rules.
Lemmatization reduces words to a dictionary lemma using vocabulary and morphology.
TF-IDF weights terms by frequency in a document and rarity across documents.
